author: Jisudeng
title: 自然窗光头像
description: 适合个人头像、社媒账号、简历形象，重点是自然、可信、干净。
promptZh: 生成一张自然可信的半身头像照片。主体正面或微微侧身看向镜头，表情放松，眼神清晰，服装简洁有质感，背景是柔和窗光下的浅色室内墙面或干净办公空间。光线从侧前方进入，形成柔和高光和自然阴影，肤色真实，头发和衣料细节清楚。构图为胸像到肩部上方，主体居中，背景轻微虚化但不模糊五官。整体风格是专业、友好、可信，不要夸张滤镜，不要过度磨皮，不要塑料质感，不要奇怪手部，不要多余文字。
promptEn: Create a natural and trustworthy half-body profile portrait. The subject faces the camera or turns slightly toward it, with a relaxed expression and clear eyes. Clothing should be simple and refined, with a soft window-lit pale interior wall or clean office space in the background. Light enters from the front side, creating gentle highlights and natural shadows. Keep skin tone realistic, with clear hair and fabric details. Frame from the chest or shoulders upward, centered, with subtle background depth while keeping facial features sharp. The overall feeling should be professional, friendly, and credible. Avoid heavy filters, over-smoothed skin, plastic texture, strange hands, or extra text.
subject: portrait

author: Jisudeng
title: 城市编辑感人像
description: 适合封面、人像写真、品牌个人形象。
promptZh: 创作一张城市编辑感人像大片。主体站在傍晚城市街角或玻璃幕墙前，人物姿态自然自信，服装具有现代时装质感，颜色不过分鲜艳。使用 85mm 人像镜头感，浅景深，背景灯光形成柔和光斑，面部保留真实皮肤纹理。画面要有杂志封面级构图，留出一侧可放标题的干净空间。光线为傍晚环境光加柔和补光，整体高级、克制、有故事感。避免过度锐化、廉价网红滤镜、变形五官、错误肢体和随机文字。
promptEn: Create an editorial city portrait. The subject stands naturally and confidently at an evening street corner or in front of a glass facade, wearing modern fashion with refined texture and controlled color. Use an 85mm portrait lens feeling, shallow depth of field, and soft background bokeh. Preserve realistic skin texture. Compose like a magazine cover with clean negative space on one side for a possible headline. Lighting should mix evening ambience with soft fill, creating a premium, restrained, story-rich mood. Avoid over-sharpening, cheap influencer filters, distorted facial features, incorrect limbs, and random text.
subject: portrait

author: Jisudeng
title: 材质清晰产品棚拍
description: 适合产品展示、详情页主视觉、品牌物料。
promptZh: 生成一张商业产品棚拍主图。产品位于画面中心，比例真实，边缘清晰，材质细节可见，例如金属反光、玻璃透明度、织物纹理或塑料细腻表面。背景为浅灰到白色无缝背景，地面有干净自然的接触阴影。灯光采用大型柔光箱效果，主光柔和，轮廓光轻微勾边，让产品立体但不过度炫光。画面要适合电商详情页和品牌官网，主体无遮挡，无多余道具，无随机文字，无水印，无夸张透视。
promptEn: Create a commercial studio product hero image. Place the product in the center with realistic proportions, crisp edges, and visible material details such as metallic reflections, glass transparency, fabric texture, or refined plastic surfaces. Use a seamless light gray to white background with a clean natural contact shadow. Lighting should feel like a large softbox setup, with gentle key light and subtle rim light to make the product dimensional without excessive glare. The image should be suitable for e-commerce details and a brand website. Keep the subject unobstructed, with no unnecessary props, random text, watermark, or exaggerated perspective.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 电商白底卖点主图
description: 适合平台商品首图，突出主体和卖点空间。
promptZh: 制作一张电商平台商品主图。产品清晰居中，占画面 70% 左右，白色或极浅灰背景，阴影干净，产品轮廓完整。画面左上或右侧预留文字卖点区域，但不要生成真实文字。产品周围可加入少量与功能相关的极简辅助元素，例如光线、材质切面、尺寸感参考或局部放大框，整体保持清爽、可信、适合直接上架。避免背景杂乱、过多装饰、错误品牌标识、乱码文字、产品结构变形。
promptEn: Create an e-commerce marketplace main image. The product should be centered, sharp, and occupy about 70% of the frame, on a white or very light gray background with a clean shadow and complete silhouette. Reserve a headline or selling-point area in the upper left or side, but do not generate actual text. Add only minimal functional supporting elements around the product, such as light accents, material cutaways, scale references, or a small detail zoom frame. Keep the composition clean, credible, and ready for listing. Avoid clutter, excessive decoration, incorrect branding, garbled text, or distorted product structure.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 新品发布海报底图
description: 适合新品、促销、活动、品牌发布海报。
promptZh: 设计一张新品发布海报底图。画面为竖版构图，中心或下方留出产品展示区域，上方留出大标题和副标题空间，但不要生成文字。背景有层次感，可以使用光影、渐变材质、几何台面和轻微景深，但整体不能杂乱。视觉风格现代商业，高级、清爽、可信，适合后期加入中文标题、价格、日期和卖点。注意主体区域和文字区域分离，避免随机文字、水印、过度复杂装饰和低质感背景。
promptEn: Design a vertical new product launch poster background. Reserve a product display area in the center or lower section, and leave clear space at the top for a headline and subheadline, but do not generate text. The background should feel layered, using light, shadow, gradient material, geometric platforms, and subtle depth of field while staying uncluttered. The visual style should be modern, commercial, premium, clean, and trustworthy, suitable for adding Chinese headlines, price, date, and selling points later. Separate the subject area from the text area. Avoid random text, watermarks, overly complex decoration, or low-quality background texture.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 社媒笔记封面
description: 适合小红书、短视频、公众号封面底图。
promptZh: 生成一张社媒内容封面底图，竖版构图，主题清楚，第一眼有强视觉焦点。主体可以是人物、产品、空间或抽象主题物，背景干净但有记忆点，预留大标题区域和小标签区域，不生成真实文字。画面要适合手机信息流快速扫读，色彩明快但不刺眼，对比明确，主体边缘清晰。整体风格专业、现代、有传播感。避免密集元素、模糊主体、随机文字、过度饱和和廉价模板感。
promptEn: Create a vertical social media cover background with a clear topic and a strong first-glance focal point. The subject can be a person, product, space, or abstract theme object. Keep the background clean but memorable, and reserve a large headline area plus a small tag area without generating actual text. The image should work well in a mobile feed, with bright but comfortable colors, clear contrast, and crisp subject edges. The overall style should feel professional, modern, and shareable. Avoid dense elements, blurry subjects, random text, oversaturation, or a cheap template look.
subject: typography

author: Jisudeng
title: 教育图解信息图
description: 适合知识科普、课程配图、讲解型长图。
promptZh: 制作一张教育图解信息图底图，用清晰的视觉层级解释一个复杂概念。画面包含一个中心主题图形，周围有 4 到 6 个分区卡片、箭头、编号圆点和简洁图标，但不要生成具体文字。布局要有阅读顺序，从左到右或从上到下自然流动。风格为干净的现代教育视觉，浅色背景，强调线条、图标、结构和留白。适合后期加入中文说明。避免真实文字、乱码、过多颜色、拥挤布局和无法识别的图标。
promptEn: Create an educational infographic background that visually explains a complex concept with clear hierarchy. Include one central thematic graphic, surrounded by 4 to 6 section cards, arrows, numbered dots, and simple icons, but do not generate actual text. The layout should have a natural reading order from left to right or top to bottom. Use a clean modern educational style with a light background, emphasizing lines, icons, structure, and negative space. It should be suitable for adding Chinese explanations later. Avoid real text, garbled characters, too many colors, crowded layout, or unrecognizable icons.
subject: diagram

author: Jisudeng
title: SaaS 仪表盘界面
description: 适合 App/Web 设计参考、产品方案页、演示图。
promptZh: 生成一张现代 SaaS 仪表盘界面视觉。画面展示桌面端 Web 应用主界面，顶部导航、左侧菜单、数据表格、筛选器、状态标签和趋势图有清晰层级。整体是工作型产品风格，密度适中，信息易扫读，卡片边角小，颜色克制，有蓝色、绿色和中性色点缀。不要做营销落地页，不要夸张英雄区，不要生成可读业务文字，可以使用抽象占位文本线条。界面要真实可用，间距统一，对齐准确。
promptEn: Create a modern SaaS dashboard interface visual. Show a desktop web app main screen with top navigation, left sidebar, data table, filters, status labels, and trend charts in a clear hierarchy. The style should be work-focused, moderately dense, easy to scan, with small-radius cards, restrained colors, and blue, green, and neutral accents. Do not create a marketing landing page or oversized hero section. Do not generate readable business text; abstract placeholder lines are acceptable. The interface should feel realistic and usable, with consistent spacing and accurate alignment.
subject: interface

author: Jisudeng
title: 游戏道具图标组
description: 适合手游、小游戏、道具栏、技能图标。
promptZh: 生成一组统一风格的游戏道具图标，排列为 4x4 网格。每个图标放在独立小方格中，包含不同类别的道具，例如能量晶体、药剂瓶、钥匙、卷轴、盾牌、靴子、徽章和宝箱。所有图标使用一致的光源、描边、材质和阴影，背景透明感或深色中性底，边缘干净，适合切图成游戏资产。风格为精致 3D 卡通与轻幻想结合。避免文字、重复图标、过度复杂背景和不统一透视。
promptEn: Create a unified set of game item icons arranged in a 4x4 grid. Each icon sits in its own small square and represents a different item type, such as energy crystal, potion bottle, key, scroll, shield, boots, badge, and treasure chest. Use consistent lighting, outline, material treatment, and shadow across all icons. The background should feel transparent or dark neutral, with clean edges suitable for slicing into game assets. The style combines polished 3D cartoon and light fantasy. Avoid text, repeated icons, overly complex backgrounds, or inconsistent perspective.
subject: icon-set

author: Jisudeng
title: 六格漫画分镜
description: 适合故事脚本、短视频脚本、漫画分镜草案。
promptZh: 制作一张六格漫画分镜页。页面包含 2 行 3 列分镜，每格有不同镜头景别：远景建立场景、中景展示角色动作、近景展示表情、特写展示关键物品、俯视展示关系、最后一格留下悬念。分镜之间留出清晰白边，画风统一，线条干净，黑白或低饱和彩色均可。不要生成对白文字或气泡文字，可以保留空白气泡位置。重点是镜头语言、节奏和情绪递进。避免角色长相不一致、画面拥挤和乱码文字。
promptEn: Create a six-panel comic storyboard page with a 2 by 3 grid. Each panel should use a different shot type: wide establishing shot, medium action shot, close-up expression, object detail shot, overhead relationship shot, and a final suspense panel. Leave clear gutters between panels. Use a consistent visual style, clean linework, and either black-and-white or low-saturation color. Do not generate dialogue text or readable speech bubbles, but empty speech bubble space is acceptable. Focus on cinematic language, pacing, and emotional progression. Avoid inconsistent character appearance, crowded frames, or garbled text.
subject: storyboard

author: Jisudeng
title: 生活方式桌面摄影
description: 适合品牌生活方式图、内容配图、产品氛围图。
promptZh: 生成一张真实生活方式桌面摄影。画面是自然光下的木质桌面，主体物品放在画面三分线附近，周围有少量协调道具，例如笔记本、咖啡杯、布料纹理或植物叶片。光线从窗边斜射，产生柔和阴影和温暖氛围。构图要有呼吸感，颜色自然，材质真实，适合品牌内容配图。不要过度摆拍，不要杂乱道具，不要文字、水印或不真实反光。
promptEn: Create a realistic lifestyle tabletop photograph. The scene is a wooden desk under natural light, with the main object placed near a rule-of-thirds point. Surround it with a few coordinated props such as a notebook, coffee cup, fabric texture, or plant leaves. Light should enter diagonally from a window, creating soft shadows and a warm atmosphere. The composition should feel breathable, with natural color and realistic materials, suitable for brand content imagery. Avoid overly staged arrangements, cluttered props, text, watermark, or unrealistic reflections.
subject: lifestyle

author: Jisudeng
title: 电影感夜街场景
description: 适合故事海报、影视概念、氛围图。
promptZh: 创作一张电影感夜晚街道场景。画面中有湿润路面反射霓虹灯和路灯，远处有轻微雾气，主体人物或物体位于画面中景，形成明确轮廓。使用宽银幕构图，低机位或平视视角，颜色以冷蓝、暖橙和少量红色点缀形成对比。光线有方向性，阴影丰富，画面具有悬念和故事感。不要恐怖血腥，不要随机文字，不要过度赛博朋克化，不要低清噪点。
promptEn: Create a cinematic nighttime street scene. Wet pavement reflects neon signs and street lamps, with subtle haze in the distance. Place the main person or object in the midground with a clear silhouette. Use a widescreen composition with a low or eye-level camera angle. Colors should contrast cool blue, warm orange, and small red accents. Lighting should be directional, with rich shadows and a sense of suspense and story. Avoid horror gore, random text, excessive cyberpunk styling, or low-resolution noise.
subject: cityscape

author: Jisudeng
title: 品牌插画角色
description: 适合 App 空状态、品牌物料、活动页角色。
promptZh: 设计一个亲和力强的品牌插画角色。角色拥有简洁轮廓、明确识别点和温和表情，姿态像是在向用户介绍产品功能。服装和配色应与现代科技品牌匹配，使用干净的矢量插画质感，少量渐变和柔和阴影增强层次。背景为浅色抽象场景，可包含简单界面卡片或功能图标，但不要生成文字。角色应适合在 App 空状态、引导页和活动页中复用。避免复杂纹理、过度拟真和难以缩小识别的细节。
promptEn: Design a friendly brand illustration character. The character should have a simple silhouette, a clear recognizable feature, and a gentle expression, posed as if introducing a product feature to the user. Clothing and colors should match a modern technology brand. Use a clean vector illustration texture, with subtle gradients and soft shadows for depth. The background is a light abstract scene with simple interface cards or functional icons, but no text. The character should be reusable in app empty states, onboarding screens, and campaign pages. Avoid complex textures, excessive realism, or details that are hard to recognize at small sizes.
subject: character

author: Jisudeng
title: 国风节日视觉
description: 适合节日海报、文化活动、国风主题封面。
promptZh: 生成一张精致国风节日视觉。画面包含山水留白、云纹、纸张纹理、朱红与墨色点缀，以及一个中心意象，例如灯笼、扇面、瓷器、月影或亭台。构图讲究留白和层次，主体不拥挤，适合后期加入中文标题。风格融合传统水墨和现代商业插画，线条细腻，颜色克制，高级而不老旧。避免随机书法文字、廉价素材拼贴、过度金色、杂乱边框和错乱纹样。
promptEn: Create a refined Chinese-style festival visual. Include landscape negative space, cloud patterns, paper texture, vermilion and ink accents, and one central motif such as a lantern, folding fan, porcelain, moonlight, or pavilion. The composition should emphasize breathing room and layers, with an uncluttered subject and space for adding a Chinese headline later. Blend traditional ink aesthetics with modern commercial illustration, using delicate linework and restrained colors. Avoid random calligraphy text, cheap collage materials, excessive gold, messy borders, or confused patterns.
subject: festival

author: Jisudeng
title: 水彩旅行明信片
description: 适合旅行内容、城市纪念图、轻柔插画风。
promptZh: 绘制一张水彩旅行明信片风格画面。主体是一处城市地标、街角咖啡店、海边步道或山间小屋，使用松弛自然的水彩笔触，边缘有轻微晕染，纸张纹理可见。画面保留天空或边缘留白，适合后期添加地点名称。色彩清新，光线柔和，氛围安静有记忆点。不要生成真实文字，不要照片质感，不要过度细节化，不要脏污纸张或混乱透视。
promptEn: Paint a watercolor travel postcard scene. The subject is a city landmark, street corner cafe, seaside walkway, or mountain cabin, rendered with relaxed natural watercolor strokes, slight bleeding at the edges, and visible paper texture. Leave clean space in the sky or around the border for adding a place name later. Colors should be fresh, lighting soft, and the atmosphere quiet and memorable. Do not generate real text, photographic texture, excessive detail, dirty paper, or chaotic perspective.
subject: landscape

author: Jisudeng
title: 像素游戏场景
description: 适合复古游戏、小游戏背景、像素风素材。
promptZh: 生成一张横版像素游戏场景背景。画面包含前景平台、中景建筑或树林轮廓、远景天空和云层，层次分明，适合横向滚动游戏。像素颗粒清晰，限制色板，光源统一，边缘硬朗但整体和谐。场景中可以有门、路牌、灯光或可交互物件位置，但不要生成文字。画面要有游戏可用性，主体区域和可行走区域明确。避免高分辨率插画质感、模糊像素、随机文字和透视混乱。
promptEn: Create a side-scrolling pixel game scene background. Include a foreground platform, midground building or forest silhouette, distant sky and clouds, with clear layered depth suitable for horizontal scrolling gameplay. Pixels should be crisp, with a limited color palette, unified light source, hard edges, and cohesive atmosphere. The scene may include positions for a door, sign, lamp, or interactive object, but no text. Make the walkable area and subject zones clear for game use. Avoid high-resolution illustration texture, blurry pixels, random text, or confused perspective.
subject: game-scene

author: Jisudeng
title: 3D App 图标
description: 适合产品图标、功能入口、品牌符号探索。
promptZh: 设计一个现代 3D App 图标。图标主体是一个清晰的抽象符号或功能隐喻，放在圆角方形底板上，材质为柔和玻璃、哑光塑料或细腻金属，光线来自左上方，阴影自然。图标要在小尺寸下仍然易识别，轮廓简单，颜色有主次层级。背景透明或极简浅色，不要文字，不要复杂小零件，不要真实品牌标识，不要过度反光。
promptEn: Design a modern 3D app icon. The main symbol should be a clear abstract mark or functional metaphor placed on a rounded-square base. Materials may include soft glass, matte plastic, or refined metal, with light from the upper left and natural shadows. The icon should remain recognizable at small sizes, with a simple silhouette and clear color hierarchy. Use a transparent or minimal light background. Avoid text, complex tiny parts, real brand logos, or excessive reflections.
subject: app-icon

author: Jisudeng
title: 温暖室内空间
description: 适合家居、装修、民宿、空间设计参考。
promptZh: 生成一张温暖现代室内空间照片。空间为客厅、书房或民宿套间，拥有自然采光、木质元素、织物沙发、低饱和装饰和整洁收纳。镜头高度接近人眼，构图能展示空间动线和主要家具。光线从大窗进入，产生柔和阴影，材质真实，空间有生活气息但不凌乱。整体像高质量家居杂志摄影。避免过度豪宅感、杂乱物品、错误透视、变形家具和不合理空间结构。
promptEn: Create a warm modern interior photograph. The space can be a living room, study, or boutique homestay suite, with natural daylight, wooden elements, fabric sofa, low-saturation decor, and tidy storage. Use an eye-level camera height and a composition that shows circulation and main furniture. Light enters from a large window, producing soft shadows. Materials should be realistic, with a lived-in atmosphere that remains uncluttered. The image should feel like high-quality home magazine photography. Avoid excessive luxury, messy objects, wrong perspective, distorted furniture, or impossible spatial structure.
subject: interior

author: Jisudeng
title: 菜单级食物摄影
description: 适合餐饮菜单、外卖图、社媒美食内容。
promptZh: 拍摄一张菜单级食物摄影。主菜放在干净餐具中，食材层次清楚，表面有自然光泽，热气或新鲜感适度表现。背景是木桌、石材台面或浅色餐布，搭配少量餐具和配料点缀，但不抢主体。镜头角度可以是 45 度或俯拍，构图适合菜单和外卖平台。颜色真实诱人，质感干净。避免过度油腻、食物变形、杂乱桌面、随机文字和不真实颜色。
promptEn: Create a menu-quality food photograph. The main dish sits in clean tableware, with clear ingredient layers, natural surface gloss, and a subtle sense of warmth or freshness. The background can be a wooden table, stone surface, or pale tablecloth, with a few utensils or ingredient accents that do not compete with the subject. Use a 45-degree angle or overhead view suitable for menus and delivery platforms. Colors should be realistic and appetizing, with clean texture. Avoid excessive grease, distorted food, messy table settings, random text, or unnatural colors.
subject: food

author: Jisudeng
title: 服装 Lookbook
description: 适合服装品牌、穿搭展示、商品详情。
promptZh: 生成一张服装 Lookbook 视觉。人物站在简洁背景前，完整展示服装版型、面料垂感、颜色和搭配层次。姿态自然，手臂和腿部比例正确，衣服轮廓清楚，不被道具遮挡。光线柔和均匀，背景可以是浅灰影棚、城市墙面或自然室外场景。画面要像品牌型录，干净、专业、可用于商品展示。避免夸张姿势、变形肢体、错误纽扣拉链、随机文字和过强滤镜。
promptEn: Create a fashion lookbook visual. The person stands against a simple background, clearly showing garment silhouette, fabric drape, color, and styling layers. The pose should be natural, with correct arm and leg proportions, and the clothing outline unobstructed by props. Lighting is soft and even. The background may be a light gray studio, urban wall, or natural outdoor setting. The image should feel like a brand catalog, clean, professional, and suitable for product display. Avoid exaggerated poses, distorted limbs, incorrect buttons or zippers, random text, or heavy filters.
subject: fashion

author: Jisudeng
title: 字体排版海报框架
description: 适合品牌海报、活动视觉、排版参考。
promptZh: 设计一张字体排版海报框架。画面以大字号标题区域、次级信息区、日期位置和行动按钮位置构成清晰层级，但不要生成真实文字，只使用抽象文字占位线或块。构图强调网格、对齐、留白和节奏，背景可以是纯色、轻微纸纹或简洁图形。风格现代、克制、适合中文活动海报后期编辑。避免乱码文字、真实品牌名、过度装饰、视觉重心混乱和难以替换的文字元素。
promptEn: Design a typography poster layout framework. Build a clear hierarchy with a large headline area, secondary information area, date placement, and call-to-action position, but do not generate real text. Use abstract placeholder lines or blocks only. The composition should emphasize grid, alignment, negative space, and rhythm. The background can be solid color, subtle paper texture, or simple graphics. The style is modern, restrained, and suitable for later Chinese event poster editing. Avoid garbled text, real brand names, excessive decoration, confused visual weight, or text elements that are hard to replace.
subject: typography

author: Jisudeng
title: App 引导页插画
description: 适合移动端引导页、功能介绍、空状态。
promptZh: 生成一张移动 App 引导页插画。画面中心是一个简洁的手机界面或功能场景，周围用柔和图形表现效率、创作、同步或安全感。背景浅色，色彩层级清晰，主体下方预留标题和描述文字空间，不生成真实文字。插画需要适配移动端首屏，主体不能太复杂，边缘干净，风格亲和、现代、可信。避免复杂背景、随机文字、过多按钮细节和无法缩小识别的元素。
promptEn: Create a mobile app onboarding illustration. The center shows a simple phone interface or feature scenario, surrounded by soft shapes that suggest efficiency, creativity, sync, or safety. Use a light background with clear color hierarchy. Reserve space below the subject for a title and description, but do not generate actual text. The illustration should fit a mobile first screen, with a subject that is not overly complex, clean edges, and a friendly, modern, trustworthy style. Avoid complex backgrounds, random text, excessive button details, or elements that cannot be recognized at small sizes.
subject: mobile-ui

author: Jisudeng
title: 产品系列横幅
description: 适合官网 Banner、活动头图、产品系列展示。
promptZh: 制作一张产品系列横幅图。画面横向构图，3 到 5 个同系列产品按主次排列，中间主产品最大，两侧产品逐渐降低视觉权重。背景使用简洁品牌色块、柔和光线和轻微空间层次，预留左侧或右侧文案区域，不生成真实文字。产品材质清晰，阴影方向统一，整体有官网首屏质感。避免产品比例混乱、背景过花、随机品牌标识、错乱文字和低质抠图感。
promptEn: Create a product series banner image. Use a horizontal composition with 3 to 5 products from the same series arranged by visual priority: the main product is largest in the center, with side products carrying less visual weight. Use simple brand color blocks, soft light, and subtle spatial depth in the background. Reserve copy space on the left or right, but do not generate actual text. Product materials should be clear, shadows consistent, and the overall feeling suitable for a website hero banner. Avoid inconsistent product scale, busy backgrounds, random brand marks, garbled text, or low-quality cutout edges.
subject: product

author: Jisudeng
title: 建筑外观概念图
description: 适合建筑展示、商业空间、方案汇报。
promptZh: 生成一张现代建筑外观概念图。建筑位于城市街角、社区入口或自然景观边缘，体块关系清晰，立面材料包括玻璃、石材、金属或木格栅。光线为清晨或傍晚，能体现建筑轮廓和空间层次。画面需要展示入口、周边尺度、景观和人行路径，但不要生成文字标牌。风格为高质量建筑可视化，真实可信，适合方案汇报。避免结构不可能、透视错误、重复窗格、随机招牌和过度梦幻化。
promptEn: Create a modern architectural exterior concept visualization. The building sits at an urban corner, community entrance, or edge of a natural landscape. Massing should be clear, with facade materials such as glass, stone, metal, or wooden screens. Use morning or evening light to reveal the silhouette and spatial layers. Show the entrance, surrounding scale, landscape, and pedestrian paths, but do not generate text signage. The style should be high-quality architectural visualization, realistic and credible for a concept presentation. Avoid impossible structure, perspective errors, repeated window artifacts, random signage, or excessive fantasy styling.
subject: architecture

author: Jisudeng
title: 角色设定三视图
description: 适合 IP 角色、游戏角色、漫画角色设定。
promptZh: 生成一张角色设定三视图。画面在同一页中展示角色正面、侧面和背面，姿态统一，比例一致，服装、发型、配饰和颜色保持完全一致。背景为浅色干净画布，可以加入小型配色块和局部细节放大框，但不要生成真实文字。角色风格可爱但不幼稚，适合游戏、漫画或品牌 IP 开发。重点是结构清楚、可复用、便于后续建模或插画延展。避免三视图不一致、服装细节错乱、乱码文字和多余角色。
promptEn: Create a character design turnaround sheet. Show the same character from front, side, and back views on one page, with consistent pose, proportions, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, and colors. Use a clean light canvas background. Add small color swatches and close-up detail boxes if useful, but do not generate real text. The character style should be charming but not childish, suitable for game, comic, or brand IP development. Focus on clear structure, reuse, and easy extension into modeling or illustration. Avoid inconsistent views, clothing detail errors, garbled text, or extra characters.
subject: character

author: Jisudeng
title: 包装盒展示 Mockup
description: 适合品牌包装、礼盒、电商详情展示。
promptZh: 生成一张包装盒展示 Mockup。包装盒以 3/4 角度摆放在简洁台面上，能看到正面和侧面结构，盒体材质清楚，例如哑光纸、压纹、局部光油或金属烫印区域。包装表面不要生成真实品牌文字，可用抽象几何图形和无意义占位条表现设计区。光线柔和，阴影干净，背景为浅色商业棚拍环境。画面适合品牌提案和电商详情。避免乱码文字、错误透视、包装边缘变形和过度反光。
promptEn: Create a packaging box mockup image. Place the box at a 3/4 angle on a simple platform so both front and side structure are visible. Show clear material qualities such as matte paper, embossing, spot gloss, or metallic foil areas. Do not generate real brand text on the packaging; use abstract geometric graphics and meaningless placeholder bars to indicate design areas. Lighting should be soft, shadows clean, and the background a light commercial studio setting. The image should work for brand proposals and e-commerce details. Avoid garbled text, wrong perspective, distorted packaging edges, or excessive reflections.
subject: packaging
